scope: New fixed-owner native HTTP hot-loop path only; historical seven 504 events are not reattributed.
status: Confirmed redundant locked self-notification removed; focused regression and original five-second preflight pass. Final source CI and sustained acceptance are separate.

source_identity.note: Diagnostic builds use the frozen cached CLI and separate private generated C. Ambient Git HEAD moved through documentation/acceptance commits; artifact hashes identify the actual binaries. The old f9d20... artifact was not reused or claimed equivalent.

timeline.execution_sampling_scope: Callback events are sampled every 64 owner polls. Factory_done follows real Task registration/enqueue; it is not a distinct exact enqueue or first-execution timestamp.

cross_owner_lock_wait.scope: Driver mutex acquisition interval overlaps owner0 self-send interval. Interval includes any scheduling delay while acquiring; not exact lock-held CPU time.

race_argument: Pump computes next_deadline=0 for remaining ready work and clears pumping under the same driver mutex.
Publication before this final locked check is reflected in the ready queue; HTTP converts the due deadline to OS poll timeout zero.
Publication after that lock observes pumping==0 and still invokes the directed external wake before the owner can sleep.
Close/fault broadcasts and ordinary external notifications remain; no timeout, quantum, ownership or M:N change.

production_change.change: Remove only pump-tail event_wake for its own already-ready continuation; update adjacent synchronization comment.

permanent_regression.before: Fails the new no-self-notification assertion on unmodified code.
permanent_regression.after: Passes, with all sixteen native_task_source_test tests passing.
assertions: Remaining ready work returns deadline zero without notifying either owner.
New publication after pump returns still wakes its target owner, without notifying the other owner.
Close still broadcasts and both owners retire, join, and return their accounted bytes.

private_candidate.scope: 280/280 success before the first 100ms diagnostic trigger stopped arrivals. Its window differs from before; not an error-rate or sustained-pass comparison. Residual off-CPU tails remain.

parameters.overload_duration_reason: 280 slow peers over 30s fits the same-host 16384 ephemeral-port budget; service deadlines unchanged
parameters.queue_bytes: fixed64 descriptors, no queued request bodies

uninstrumented_fixed_preflight.scope: Actual release C from rebuilt CLI; no diagnostic ring, libproc observer, or sample process. Original five-second threshold only; not a thirty-minute claim.

environment_and_limits: All owner threads requested QoS class 21 (DEFAULT), relative priority zero; nice zero. No DARWINBG/external-DARWINBG/SUPPRESSED process flag was set.
A system sample after diagnosis showed 8 GiB host memory and about 11.5 GiB swap in use. It is environment evidence, not proof of the unique stall cause.
Root closed its own GitHub editor tab/TextEdit during this work. UI/host conditions were not frozen across diagnostic rounds; no UI change is credited as a runtime fix.
The remaining 306.127ms interval lies between OS poll return and the next pump entry, including wake drain and loop maintenance; it was not uniquely attributed.
Several poll(timeout=0) and pure pump intervals also accrued wall time with very little thread CPU. Snapshot RUNNING does not establish continuous CPU execution or exclude short unsampled waits.
Native owner identity is exported once using THREAD_IDENTIFIER_INFO.thread_handle and verified unique thread ID, not guessed from pthread pointer offsets.
The prestarted stack sampler is diagnostic instrumentation; aggregate stacks do not provide a timestamp for every frame and may affect scheduling.
504 selection is precisely correlated; the interval from selection to client response completion is not uniquely split into socket write and client scheduling.
The retained raw rusage CPU/QoS metadata uses Mach ticks, calibrated separately at ratio 0.024 to process CPU nanoseconds; timebase 125/3 conversion is explicit.
The new five-second pass does not prove every off-CPU tail fixed or substitute for final three-OS and formal acceptance. Historical seven failures remain unconfirmed.
